malformed_query._about: L1.9 part 2 (CARRIES row 150): the other answer Athena may give a statement that does not parse, refused at StartQueryExecution rather than run and FAILED. Modelled from the API reference (StartQueryExecution's InvalidRequestException, with its AthenaErrorCode and Message), not measured: no Athena is reachable from this build. The message is the parser's own, as a FAILED execution's reason gives it. test_athena_connector_live.py says which of the two Athena does, on the client's platform.

syntax_eof._about: A statement that ends where Athena expects more (a dangling WHERE). The column is the statement's length plus one. Whether Athena reports a syntax error as a FAILED execution (modelled here) or as an InvalidRequestException at StartQueryExecution is unconfirmed until part 2 (test_athena_connector_live.py's unparseable-query case).

catalog_not_found._about: A catalog Athena does not hold, in QueryExecutionContext.Catalog or in a three-part name (the orchestrator's review of L1.9, round 1, item 7). Its words and whether it fails as an execution are Trino's error name, unconfirmed until part 2.
